title: Two Young Children by Wading Pool, 1960s Backyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing two young blonde children by a portable vinyl kiddie pool on a bright, sunny summer afternoon. The young boy stands in front of the pool wearing plaid swimsuit trunks, while a smaller toddler wearing a striped swimsuit leans against the side of the pool. The backyard setting includes lush grass, dappled tree shadows, a wooden fence, and vintage lawn furniture, reflecting postwar American suburban family life and domestic leisure during the mid-20th century.
